title: Control Flow and Array Processing Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Control Flow and Array Processing.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about truthiness is valid?

options.text: non-empty strings including '0' and 'false' are truthy
conditions convert non-boolean values using defined truthiness rules
convert user intent explicitly when strings such as 'false' are possible
It can only be used inside a class

questions.explanation: non-empty strings including '0' and 'false' are truthy. Verify this behavior with a minimal runnable example and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about nullish coalescing is valid?

options.text: using || can replace valid zero or empty-string input
?? defaults only null or undefined
use ?? when zero and empty string are valid values
It can only be used inside a class

questions.explanation: using || can replace valid zero or empty-string input. Verify this behavior with a minimal runnable example and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about optional chaining is valid?

options.text: optional chaining does not validate a present value's type

use optional chaining for genuinely optional nested data
It can only be used inside a class

questions.explanation: optional chaining does not validate a present value's type. Verify this behavior with a minimal runnable example and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about for of is valid?

options.text: for...in yields property keys rather than array values

use for...of for array values when no index is needed
It can only be used inside a class

questions.explanation: for...in yields property keys rather than array values. Verify this behavior with a minimal runnable example and observable output.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about array map is valid?

options.text: ignoring map's returned array loses the transformed result
